mapper.select: select exists (select 1 from sys_code_grp where grp_cd = #{grpCd} and use_yn = 'Y')

select code, null as code_nm, code_nm_key, sort_no, true as system_yn, attrs::text as attrs from sys_code c where grp_cd = #{grpCd} and use_yn = 'Y' -- 회사가 숨긴 시스템 코드는 선택 목록에서만 뺀다(docs/68 Q4 — RLS 로 이 회사 숨김만, 이름표·저장 검사는 그대로) and not exists (select 1 from sys_comp_code_hide h where h.grp_cd = c.grp_cd and h.code = c.code) union all select code, code_nm, null, sort_no, false, attrs::text from sys_comp_code where grp_cd = #{grpCd} and use_yn = 'Y' order by sort_no, code

select code, null as code_nm, code_nm_key, sort_no, true as system_yn, null as attrs from sys_code where grp_cd = #{grpCd} union all select code, code_nm, null, sort_no, false, null from sys_comp_code where grp_cd = #{grpCd} order by sort_no, code
